stats.notes: No Common Data Set found: Mizzou's official CDS page (udair.missouri.edu/mu-data/common-data-set) links PDFs only through 2023-24, and those are SharePoint files that ask for a Microsoft sign-in (HTTP 401), so CDS-only items (residency and international splits of applicants, GPA, waitlist, admission factors) are not added. Figures are IPEDS (fall 2024 entering class): 24,490 applied, 19,218 admitted (78%), 5,953 enrolled (31% of admitted); counts come from the NCES admissions file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal and match College Navigator's 78% admitted / 31% yield. SAT and ACT percentiles cover only the 10% (580 students) and 66% (3,583 students) of enrolled first-years who sent scores. Undergraduate enrollment is 24,449 and there are 284 nonresident undergraduates (IPEDS fall 2024); the 17:1 student-to-faculty ratio is from College Navigator.

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.
